sources.flight: DESIGN: the closed-form launch (gravity + linear drag) must agree with the integrated ball physics; an elite passer (99) lands a 30 m lançamento near the target's feet
sources.duel: GAME_DESIGN §20: 'disputa por posição > altura + Força + Cabeceio'. A much better header (Cabeceio + Força) wins most duels at equal distance; DESIGN ESTIMATE for 'most'
sources.headless: DESIGN ESTIMATE (A9a, X-73): the AI crosses from the cross zone and plays some lançamentos; headers happen every match; real-football references (scaled by the rhythm of X-65): ~15-20% of goals are headers (ESTIMATE, widely reported)
